answer: Admission requires a locked sable bond sized to one epoch of expected emission, plus a single quill signing key bound to that bond. Every liveness pulse must be signed by that quill and include a monotonic nonce. Peers maintain a public quill-to-address index and will not attest a pulse whose quill already maps to another address; a conflict lets any attestor slash the sable bond in full. A sybil attacker must therefore fund a separate bond for each fake identity, and key reuse is automatically loss-making.
